name: Boracef Ceftriaxone for Injection
shortDescription: Prescription injectable cephalosporin antibiotic for clinician-directed hospital and clinical therapy.
description: Boracef Ceftriaxone is a broad-spectrum, third-generation bactericidal cephalosporin antibiotic formulated for intravenous administration. Indicated for severe, susceptible systemic bacterial infections under trained clinician administration.
useCase: For clinical management of severe respiratory, urinary tract, intra-abdominal, and septic bacterial infections. For I.V. use only; requires professional reconstitution.
regulatoryInfo: NAFDAC Reg. No: B4-1435. Marketed by Vitborah Pharmaceutical Company Ltd.

name: Boraflox 500 Ciprofloxacin Tablets
shortDescription: High-potency fluoroquinolone antibiotic for confirmed susceptible bacterial infections.
description: Boraflox 500 contains ciprofloxacin hydrochloride, providing bactericidal activity by inhibiting bacterial DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV. Prescribed in accordance with clinical culture and sensitivity guidelines.
useCase: Prescription antibiotic for susceptible urinary, respiratory, skin and gastrointestinal bacterial infections in adult patients under medical direction.

name: Artborah Tablets
shortDescription: First-line Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) for uncomplicated malaria.
description: Artborah is a fixed-dose oral antimalarial combination therapy designed to rapidly clear Plasmodium falciparum parasites and prevent recrudescence, aligning with WHO malaria treatment guidelines.
useCase: Treatment of acute, uncomplicated malaria infections caused by Plasmodium falciparum in adults and children under medical guidance.

name: Vitboter Artemether Injection
shortDescription: Injectable antimalarial for healthcare facility emergency administration.
description: Vitboter Artemether is a lipid-soluble artemisinin derivative for intramuscular injection in emergency clinical settings where oral therapy cannot be tolerated.
useCase: Clinician-directed emergency treatment of severe malaria or when patients are vomiting and unable to take oral ACT medication.

name: Vitborah Artesunate for Injection 60mg
shortDescription: Parenteral artesunate injection (60 mg) formulated for intravenous or intramuscular clinical administration.
description: Vitborah Artesunate for Injection 60 mg is a parenteral antimalarial formulation prepared for intravenous (IV) or intramuscular (IM) administration in hospital and clinic settings under trained practitioner supervision.
useCase: Clinician-directed parenteral antimalarial therapy (IV or IM use) in hospital and clinical facilities.

name: Vitborah Artesunate for Injection 120mg
shortDescription: Higher-strength 120 mg artesunate injectable for intravenous or intramuscular hospital administration.
description: Vitborah Artesunate for Injection 120 mg provides a higher-strength parenteral presentation for IV or IM administration in hospital wards and clinical centres under licensed medical oversight.
useCase: Hospital and clinic parenteral antimalarial administration (IV or IM use) where a 120 mg vial presentation is required under physician direction.

name: Augborah-625 Tablets
activeIngredients: Amoxicillin & Potassium Clavulanate Tablets BP (625 mg)
shortDescription: Broad-spectrum Amoxicillin and Potassium Clavulanate BP tablets for clinician-prescribed antibacterial therapy.
description: Augborah-625 combines Amoxicillin and Potassium Clavulanate BP in a 2 × 7 blister tablet pack, supporting effective oral antibacterial treatment across susceptible infections under medical prescription.
useCase: Prescription oral antibacterial therapy for susceptible bacterial infections as directed by a licensed physician or dispensing pharmacist.

name: Staxim 500 Cefuroxime Axetil Tablets
shortDescription: Broad-spectrum cephalosporin for respiratory, ENT, and soft tissue infections.
description: Staxim 500 contains cefuroxime axetil, an oral prodrug that is hydrolyzed to cefuroxime, exerting bactericidal action against a wide spectrum of Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens.
useCase: Indicated for upper and lower respiratory tract infections, otitis media, tonsillitis, and uncomplicated urinary tract infections.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts (W.H.O. Recommended ORS)
activeIngredients: Sodium chloride 2.60 g, potassium chloride 1.50 g, sodium citrate 2.90 g, anhydrous glucose 13.50 g per sachet
shortDescription: WHO-standard oral electrolyte and fluid replacement formula with pleasant orange flavour.
description: Vitborah W.H.O. Recommended ORS restores essential electrolytes and fluid balance lost through acute diarrhoeal illness, vomiting, intense perspiration, and heat exhaustion in pediatric and adult patients.
useCase: Fast oral rehydration therapy for children, infants, and adults suffering dehydration from gastrointestinal illness.

name: Vitbonac 50 Diclofenac Potassium Tablets
shortDescription: Rapid-acting analgesic and anti-inflammatory formulation for acute pain relief.
description: Vitbonac provides rapid analgesic action via diclofenac potassium, which exhibits faster absorption than the sodium salt, effectively reducing prostaglandin synthesis in acute painful conditions.
useCase: Short-term relief of acute pain and inflammatory episodes, including post-traumatic pain, dental pain, dysmenorrhoea, and musculoskeletal flare-ups.

name: Vitborah Tramadol Capsules BP 100mg
shortDescription: Prescription Tramadol Capsules BP 100 mg in a 10 × 10 institutional pack for medically supervised analgesia.
description: Vitborah Tramadol Capsules BP 100 mg are packaged in 10 × 10 institutional boxes for controlled prescription-only pain management under direct physician and pharmacy oversight.
useCase: Controlled prescription analgesic therapy administered strictly under licensed physician and pharmacist supervision.

name: Vitborah Timolol Eye Drops BP 0.5%
shortDescription: Ophthalmic solution for lowering elevated intraocular pressure in glaucoma management.
description: Vitborah Timolol Eye Drops 0.5% is a sterile ophthalmic solution that effectively reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing aqueous humor formation in ocular hypertension and open-angle glaucoma.
useCase: Prescription ocular care to control elevated intraocular pressure in patients with chronic open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension under ophthalmological care.

name: Venita Gentamicin Eye/Ear Drops 0.3% w/v
shortDescription: Aminoglycoside antibiotic drops for superficial bacterial infections of the eye and outer ear canal.
description: Venita Gentamicin Eye/Ear Drops 0.3% w/v is a sterile 10 mL aminoglycoside antibiotic preparation from Vitborah formulated for targeted topical ocular and otic bacterial care.
useCase: Topical treatment of superficial bacterial infections of the eye (such as bacterial conjunctivitis or corneal ulcers) and outer ear canal infections (otitis externa).

name: Venicol Chloramphenicol Eye Drops 0.5% w/v
shortDescription: Broad-spectrum Chloramphenicol ophthalmic solution USP 0.5% w/v for bacterial ocular infections.
description: Venicol Chloramphenicol Ophthalmic Solution USP 0.5% w/v provides broad-spectrum topical antibiotic coverage in a sterile 10 mL ophthalmic dropper bottle for clinician-guided eye infection management.
useCase: Topical ophthalmic treatment of superficial bacterial infections of the eye such as bacterial conjunctivitis under medical supervision.

name: Boraclear Triple-Action Topical Cream
therapeuticSubcategory: Antifungal, potent corticosteroid, antibacterial & Vitamin-E cream
activeIngredients: Ketoconazole, Clobetasol Propionate, Neomycin Sulfate & Vitamin-E Cream
shortDescription: Coming soon: topical cream for inflamed mixed skin infections involving fungi and bacteria.
description: Boraclear Cream combines Ketoconazole, Clobetasol Propionate, Neomycin Sulfate, and Vitamin-E in 30 g topical tubes (10 × 30 g outer pack). Formulated to address inflamed mixed fungal and bacterial skin infections while calming redness and itching.
useCase: Topical treatment of inflamed, mixed skin infections involving fungi and bacteria (such as stubborn ringworm, fungal dermatitis, or infected eczema), helping to clear the infection, soothe severe redness and itching, and support skin healing.

name: Borbact Triple-Action Topical Cream
activeIngredients: Clotrimazole, Betamethasone Dipropionate & Neomycin Sulfate Cream
shortDescription: Coming soon: topical cream for inflamed skin infections complicated by mixed fungal and bacterial organisms.
description: Borbact Cream pairs Clotrimazole, Betamethasone Dipropionate, and Neomycin Sulfate in 30 g topical tubes (12 × 30 g pack), formulated to manage inflamed skin infections involving both fungal and bacterial organisms.
useCase: Topical treatment of inflamed skin infections complicated by mixed fungal and bacterial organisms (such as infected ringworm, jock itch, or eczema), helping to clear the infection while reducing redness, swelling, and itching.

name: Skibora Dual-Action Topical Cream
shortDescription: Coming soon: dual-action topical cream for short-term relief of stubborn, severely inflamed fungal skin infections.
description: Skibora Cream combines Clobetasol Propionate and Clotrimazole in 30 g tubes (10 × 30 g display carton), engineered for short-term topical management of stubborn, severely inflamed fungal skin infections.
useCase: Short-term topical relief of stubborn, severely inflamed fungal skin infections (such as severe tinea/ringworm, athlete's foot, or fungal dermatitis) accompanied by intense itching and redness.

name: Vitborah Ceftriaxon 1g Injection
activeIngredients: Ceftriaxone (as sodium salt) 1 g per vial
shortDescription: Hospital-grade broad spectrum antibacterial injectable.
description: Sterile injectable third-generation cephalosporin designed for institutional clinical care. Effective against extended-spectrum bacterial pathogens when administered under medical surveillance.
useCase: For inpatient management of severe systemic infections, surgical prophylaxis, and acute pulmonary or meningeal infections.

name: Venita Gentamycin Injection B.P.
shortDescription: Potent aminoglycoside for targeted, serious Gram-negative bacterial infections.
description: Venita Gentamycin Injection provides potent bactericidal activity against susceptible aerobic Gram-negative bacilli. Must be administered under strict professional monitoring for renal and vestibular parameters.
useCase: Hospital-based treatment of serious hospital-acquired infections, septicaemia, and complex urinary or pelvic infections.

name: Vicocin Lincomycin 500mg Capsules
shortDescription: Lincosamide antibiotic indicated for penicillin-allergic patients with susceptible infections.
description: Vicocin contains lincomycin hydrochloride, offering targeted antibacterial coverage against Gram-positive staphylococci and streptococci for patients who cannot receive penicillins.
useCase: Oral prescription therapy for skin, bone, joint, and respiratory infections caused by susceptible organisms.

name: Venicin Griseofulvin 500mg Tablets
shortDescription: Systemic oral antifungal agent for persistent dermatophyte ringworm infections.
description: Venicin is an oral antifungal antibiotic that binds to keratin in newly formed skin, hair, and nails, rendering them resistant to fungal invasion by Trichophyton and Microsporum species.
useCase: Treatment of dermatophyte infections of the scalp (tinea capitis), body (tinea corporis), and feet (tinea pedis) when topical therapy is insufficient.

name: Levotreat Levofloxacin 500mg Tablets
shortDescription: Broad-spectrum oral fluoroquinolone for severe bacterial pulmonary and urinary conditions.
description: Levotreat is an advanced fluoroquinolone antibiotic with enhanced Gram-positive and atypical pathogen coverage, prescribed in accordance with strict clinical antibiotic stewardship.
useCase: Specialized prescription therapy for complicated urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis, and acute bacterial sinusitis.

name: Vitborah Vitamin B-Complex Injection
activeIngredients: Balanced Vitamin B-complex sterile parenteral solution
shortDescription: Parenteral vitamin B formulation for rapid restorative nutritional therapy.
description: Vitborah Vitamin B-Complex Injection provides sterile, bioavailable B-vitamins for patients experiencing severe malabsorption, post-operative debility, or acute deficiency states under clinical guidance.
useCase: Hospital-administered therapy for severe metabolic depletion, neuropathy management, and intensive nutritional support.

name: Apricona Fluconazole 150mg Tablets
shortDescription: Single-dose or short-course triazole antifungal for candidiasis and fungal infections.
description: Apricona contains fluconazole, a synthetic triazole antifungal agent that inhibits fungal cytochrome P-450 sterol C-14 alpha-demethylation, stopping fungal cell membrane synthesis.
useCase: Clinician-recommended treatment for vaginal candidiasis, mucosal fungal infections, and systemic candida conditions.

name: Appedor Nutritional Appetite Syrup
shortDescription: Syrup formulation supporting appetite stimulation and restorative convalescent nutrition.
description: Appedor Syrup combines essential amino acids and B-vitamins with cyproheptadine to assist patients recovering from prolonged illness who experience poor appetite and debility.
useCase: For medically supervised convalescent support in patients suffering from appetite loss and convalescent wasting.

name: Vibiron Hematinic & Nutritional Syrup
activeIngredients: Ferrous iron, B-Complex Vitamins, and Zinc
shortDescription: Fortified hematinic syrup providing essential iron, zinc, and B-vitamins for blood formation.
description: Vibiron Syrup delivers well-tolerated oral iron fortified with zinc and essential B-complex cofactors to support healthy hemoglobin synthesis, red blood cell formation, and overall vitality.
useCase: Nutritional replenishment for individuals with high iron demands, during pregnancy (under medical guidance), convalescence, or inadequate dietary intake.
